spans.s: पलद्यादि a class of words headed by the word पलदी to which the tad. affix अण् is applied in the miscellaneous ( शैषिक) senses; e g- पालद:, पारिषदः, रौमक:: पाटच्चर: etc. cf. Kaas, on
पलाशादि a class of words headed by the word पलाश to which the affix अ (अञ् ) is added in the sense of 'a product of' or 'a part of;' e. g. पालश:, खादिरः, वैकङ्कतः etc. cf Kaas. on
